items.computation: This is a private-law payment obligation from a company (not an authority), so no deemed-delivery rule applies; the period runs from the invoice date itself. Anchor: Rechnungsdatum 17.12.2025 (Wednesday). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (17.12.) is not counted, so counting starts 18.12.2025. Adding 7 days (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) lands on Wednesday, 24.12.2025. That day is a normal working day in NRW (not a Sunday, Saturday or statutory public holiday - Christmas Eve itself is not a legal holiday), so no § 193 BGB shift is needed. Due date: 24.12.2025.
